$source: pkg/prosemirror-minimap/docs/parity.md Part B (Phase-1 handoff). One entry per live invariant INV-1..INV-22.
$note: status 'standing-assert' = an assertion encoded in this suite that runs on EVERY execution (record and verify alike), turning captured values into proofs of the mockup oracle. 'partial' = the DOM-observable half is asserted; the listed remainder is deferred. portVerification follows parity.md Part B's verification tags: 'golden-master' INVs are re-verified by re-running this suite against the package adapter (Phase 4); 'deferred-unit' INVs are proven by the port's own headless suite (pkg/prosemirror-minimap/test.mjs).

invariants.assertion: Thumb drag ↔ scroll round-trip identity: mmThumbToScroll(top) reproduces the scroll whose mmPan places the thumb at top; a full top→bottom drag sweeps the document start→end.

where: invariants.parity.ts › INV-1 (drag to f=0/1/0.37/0.62; ends exact; inverse reproduced within the thumb's 0.5px pixel quantization)
lib/invariantAsserts.ts › INV-1 (thumb.top = frac×track ±1.5px at every frame; bottom frame scrollTop = maxScroll ±2)

invariants.assertion: Spine viewport-independence: spine membership computed once per build; scrolling never changes which spine labels exist.

where: lib/invariantAsserts.ts › INV-2 (per-canvasH-plateau shown-spine set stability with the documented ±1 active-reservation allowance; spine minimum ≥ min(8, lvl1Count) at every stop; label population constant at every frame)
invariants.parity.ts › INV-2 (full label+block census deep-equal across f=0/0.5/1 and an annex jump)

invariants.assertion: Label gap rules: ≥11px to any spine label either side; adjacent details may cluster at 7px; detail within 11px below the next spine is dropped.

where: lib/invariantAsserts.ts › INV-3 (consecutive shown labels respect 11px/7px floors per the lastWasDetail rule, at every frame)
coverage.remainder: The drop-rule half (a would-be detail within 11px below the next spine label is omitted) asserts absence — deferred to the port's unit suite where label decisions are inspectable.

invariants.assertion: Active lookup: the first segment ENDING after the viewport center (d0 test dropped); trailing fallback covers past-end.

where: lib/invariantAsserts.ts › INV-4 (the viewport center, mapped through the linear model, lands inside the active piece's map extent ±4-5px B′ piecewise deviation, at every frame)
coverage.remainder: Exact first-ending-after semantics (incl. gap residence and the past-end fallback) is a unit-side rowAt property.

invariants.assertion: Piece-local, segment-derived active highlight: the current piece is the piece whose run contains the authoritative segment; no coordinate conversion on the highlight path.

where: lib/invariantAsserts.ts › INV-5 (≤1 active piece; co-pieces exist only alongside one; every co-piece carries the active element's title — the mockup marks .active/.co-piece together on one element's pieces)

invariants.assertion: Doc-frame offset (fix #3): all fraction/lookup inputs measured from #doc's top, converted once (scrollTop − docTop0).

where: lib/invariantAsserts.ts › INV-1/INV-8 asserts (every predicted placement uses (scrollTop − docTop0); a container-frame reading would displace the thumb by docTop0/track ≈ 0.9px at the top and break the end-pin checks)
coverage.remainder: The port's contentOrigin rebasing is a unit property of measureContentOrigin.

invariants.assertion: Exact scrollable-range denominator (frame-mixing fix): every fraction uses the exact range of the scrolling frame.

where: lib/invariantAsserts.ts › INV-1 (placement formula uses scrollHeight − clientHeight − docTop0; the INV-1 drag test's bottom equality ±2px would fail by ~195px under the docHeight−clientH mix the fix removed)
coverage.remainder: maxScroll = scrollHeight − clientHeight of the resolved container is a unit property.

invariants.assertion: Content-anchored pan (fix #1): the map behind the thumb IS the reading position; pan = m0 − thumbTop; clamp guards only degenerate subsampling.

where: lib/invariantAsserts.ts › INV-8 (unclamped frames satisfy pan + thumbTop = H×s0/total ±2.5px; panY within [0, H−pane]; pan+thumbTop monotone along consecutive scroll runs)
coverage.remainder: The port-side identity frac×travel ≡ scrollTop×scale − windowOrigin is a unit algebra property, asserted numerically there.

invariants.assertion: Active-label reservation: the active element's label is always shown; on collision the single nearest shown label within 11px is displaced; at most one label swaps per frame.

where: lib/invariantAsserts.ts › INV-9 (every frame with an active block has exactly one shown .active label identifying that block)
coverage.remainder: Single-victim/bounded-churn quantification rides the INV-2 allowance (±1 added / ±1 missing per frame) and the recorded label sequences; explicit churn counting is unit-side.

invariants.assertion: Proportional tiling: segments tile the document (padding folded into first/last); Σsegments spans [0, total]; block starts linear in document coordinates.

where: lib/invariantAsserts.ts › INV-10 (census: first block top = 0; last block bottom = canvasH ±3; tops non-decreasing)
coverage.remainder: offsets[0]=0 / contiguity / total=Σ are unit properties of the port's prefix-sum model.

invariants.assertion: Extent truth at the ends: the map spans the full scrollable track; thumb-at-bottom ≡ maxScroll.

where: lib/invariantAsserts.ts › INV-11 (fraction-0 frames pin thumb.top ≤1px; fraction-1 frames pin thumb.top to track bottom ±1.5px and scrollTop to maxScroll ±2)

invariants.assertion: ResizeObserver no-op guard: a pane-height change within the guard band triggers no rebuild; only real layout changes do.

coverage.rationale: Driving a pane resize deterministically changes every geometry field at once (viewport-level resize), and the scenario vocabulary has no pane-resize step; the mockup's >2px guard is structural to its rebuild-from-resize architecture, which the port does not share (VAC-5). Revisit with the Phase-4 adapter if a package-side resize step is added.

invariants.assertion: Zoom-preserving rebuild: a grip resize (or double-click reset) rebuilds at a new canvas height while restoring the same scroll fraction.

where: lib/invariantAsserts.ts › INV-13 (doc-frame scroll fraction identical ±0.002 across every zoom / zoom-reset step, i.e. within the scrollTop integer round)

invariants.assertion: Finest-containing-element tick placement: a diagnostic inside 8.1.1 marks 8.1.1's rect, not the whole of 8.

coverage.rationale: Requires attributing a lane tick to its element; the mockup's mmBlockFor ancestor walk lives in closures and leaves no DOM trace on the tick. Census records tick geometry for cross-side comparison; the innermost-row property is rowAtPos's unit contract.

invariants.assertion: Marker height floor: lane ticks never paint below a floor (mockup 5px; port 6 device px); worst-case rects per lane ≤ canvasHeight/floor.

where: lib/invariantAsserts.ts › INV-15 (census: diag/com/search ticks within [5,14]px; wear ≥3px; per-lane tick count ≤ canvasH/floor)

invariants.assertion: Thumb height = the viewport's true share of the map surface (m1−m0), floored.

coverage.status: standing-assert (partial: exact 8px floor; share model banded)
where: lib/invariantAsserts.ts › INV-16 (height ≥8px and ≤paneH exactly; |height − max(8, H×V/total)| ≤ 12% — the mockup's piecewise B′ map compresses the share by a measured ~4-7%, documented; the port's uniform scale makes the model exact and is compared through the master diff/deviation register)

invariants.assertion: Keyboard walking operates only on SHOWN labels, starting from the active one, clamped at both ends of the shown list.

where: invariants.parity.ts › INV-17 (each ArrowDown/Up reveals the next/previous shown label's element — landing within a documented ±60px band of the center alignment; active label is the target or a descendant; repeated presses past the end stop moving the document)

invariants.assertion: Lane clicks never travel; a lane tick click reveals its own element. Content-region clicks center the target.

coverage.rationale: Same tick→element attribution gap as INV-14; the never-travels half becomes meaningful with the package's span hit-test, proven in its unit suite.

invariants.assertion: Spine sizing: spineN = max(8, min(18−3, lvl1Count)); an even sample over ordered level-1 labels with the last index clamped.

where: lib/invariantAsserts.ts › INV-19 (shown lv1 ⊆ census population; per-frame count within [min(8, lvl1Count), 15+1 reserved])
coverage.remainder: Even-sample selection order is computed once per build and is only inspectable unit-side.

invariants.assertion: Strip travel clamps the pointer to the strip extent, then centers: scrollTop = mapToDoc(y) − clientHeight/2 in the doc frame.

coverage.rationale: No strip-pointer step type in the scenario vocabulary yet (the strip's setPointerCapture also resists synthetic events). Candidate step for a later phase; the port's precise-center rule is unit-proven.

invariants.assertion: Wear boundedness: heat ∈ [0, 1.6] for all segments at all times; painted opacity ∈ [0, .8]; decay alone drives heat → 0 monotonically.

where: wear.parity.ts › INV-21 asserts (opacity ∈ [0, 0.8] at every capture; overlapping ticks non-decreasing across dwell ticks; non-overlapping ticks strictly decay — measured ×0.996² after two ticks)

invariants.assertion: Wear cadence: heat updates on a fixed 250ms tick from the doc-frame viewport overlap fraction (+0.05×overlap) plus a center bonus (+0.09), decayed ×0.996.

where: wear.parity.ts › INV-22 asserts (after phase alignment: 249ms of virtual time changes nothing; the 250th ms fires exactly one tick; exact tick counts per dwell; deterministic float opacities recorded as the wear master)
coverage.remainder: The exact producer formula (overlap fraction + center bonus coefficients) is unit-side; the D8 quantization question is a gate item.
